g.text: Bridge internals (M3): core, trust gate, store, plugin ABI, tails, provider child processes
Asks whether a version is confirmed or covered
Launches the role with the spawn key
Publishes goal revisions, receives outcome proposals
Asks for signatures of its outbound messages; the key never leaves the keeper
Signs outbound items on behalf of the posting agent
Admitted message checked against the addressee's grants before the doorbell
Stores the body with its verification record
inbox read returns the body and the verification record
Remote agents receive tasks through the mailbox like local ones
Hands the composed plan to intake; drives initialize
Rechecks gates before exec; holds the transferred lease
Re-verifies grants and revocation at enqueue and dispatch
Atomic id claim and admission record; outbox; audit
Durable idempotent enqueue; acceptance after host ack
